lines.text: Keep the envelope. They're expensive.

lines.text: They wanted someone who could get up at four.

lines.text: That coat wants a button. Nobody wants a coat without a button.

opening.text: You've been standing there so long I shall have to dust you.

lines.speaker: finch

lines.speaker: finch
lines.text: Three different shades of white. Apparently paper has a social hierarchy.

lines.speaker: finch
lines.text: I'm going to look for my cardigan. It may have gone into management.

lines.text: I mean it.

lines.text: I know. Look at that sleeve. Come here a moment.

lines.speaker: finch
lines.text: That clock is a public scandal.

lines.speaker: finch
lines.text: Tea's gone cold. That seems to be its principal occupation.

lines.speaker: finch

opening.speaker: finch
opening.text: The nicest thing about that window is that it doesn't ask questions.

lines.speaker: finch
